latest.title: A Thorpe Trick for the Bochner Technique
latest.abstract: We prove that for $n \geq 6$ there exists $\varepsilon (n)>0$ such that every closed orientable Riemannian manifold with $\left( \lceil \frac{n}{2} \rceil+ \varepsilon\right)$-positive curvature operator is a real homology sphere. For $n=6$ we show that the same result holds for manifolds with $4$-positive curvature operators.
latest.workSummary: 在略弱于整数阈值的曲率算子正性下证明闭定向高维流形为实同调球，并给出六维4正结果。
latest.breakthrough: 提高由曲率算子正性推出同调消失的范围。
latest.limitations: 实同调球不等于同胚球；ε 依赖维数。 已补读引言或主结果片段，尚未逐行验证完整证明。
latest.aiEvidence: 作者明确声明 ChatGPT 辅助论文发展，但文字由作者撰写。
latest.priorityReason: 曲率与拓扑之间的定量阈值改进直接相关。
